ISOBMFF box reader for the HEIF container (clean-room implementation). Box framing layout per ISO/IEC 14496-12 §8.3: size(32) + type(4CC), with size==1 meaning a 64-bit largesize follows, size==0 meaning "to end of file". FullBox adds version(8) + flags(24). No code is taken from any existing HEIF implementation; the observed fixture bytes under tests/fixtures/heif/ plus the Nokia HEIF technical overview were used only to confirm which boxes real writers emit.

  boxOff*: int

A located box: typ is the 4CC, payloadOff/payloadLen delimit the payload bytes inside the original buffer. 
HeifDecodeError = object of CatchableError
